regions.merged_text: "To know is to Appreciate" Trees are known by their fruits - Artists may be known by their master-pieces God Himself can be appreciated - loved - only inasmuch as He is known. The following pages offer a practical Introduction to God's most outstanding masterpiece - His own Virgin Mother Mary Immaculate. Studying Mary's life ... is learning to love .. · God in His works - His Masterpiece.
